reason: I like that it is Apache-2.0 and self-hostable, so I would maybe try the free version on a spare box, but I would not pay $99 a month for someone else to run the server. Pre-alpha from one developer is not something I put client work on overnight.
objection: One developer, pre-alpha, and agents opening PRs on client repos while nobody watches. If it breaks or the developer stops, I am stuck with flows nobody else maintains.
would_change_my_mind: A few months of other agencies running it on real client repos, with a second maintainer and a simple self-host setup I can do in an afternoon.
